Unit titling is the legal step that turns a dual occupancy into two separately owned properties - each with its own title. Once titled, you can sell one and keep one, or sell both independently. It is what converts a building project into two separate assets, and it is often where the real financial upside lives for homeowners on larger blocks.
 
 Your block qualifies for unit titling under current rules. The process: build both dwellings, complete construction to certification, then apply to separate the titles. You must build before you can title — you cannot sell bare land in RZ1. One of the two dwellings must be 120m2 or less to meet the eligibility condition.
